# Mod

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
value Mod divisor
```

## Description

The remainder after dividing the value by the divisor, written between the two numbers. The result has the sign of the value.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print 7 Mod 3
Print -7 Mod 3
Print 10 Mod 5
```

```text
1
-1
0
```
